sample: All 12 ambiguous positives originally supplied by an independent AI author on original frame video_054907 F781. All use the same intended vehicles/area. Fresh natural typed input per browser page with empty history. No pointing or correction. Twelve counterexamples were previously checked separately for the special clarification rule.
scoring: One untouched first attempt per phrase. Credit an explicit pair-specific identifying question or a proposal with both originally intended anchor boxes at minimum matched IoU >= 0.5 and point inside the registered region. Keep generic requests to mark a patch, missing evidence, wrong proposals and all operational errors as separate outcomes. A visible pair picker is an available human action and receives no automatic accuracy credit. Never confirm any of these trials.
question_rule: Earlier pair-specific rubric: a question must contain a distinguishing request and an explicit pair reference. Generic reference to only a landmark or road patch receives no pair-specific credit.
known_before_run: The 24-phrase CPU classification was already measured, with 4 of these 12 intercepted and 8 delegated. No selected native application outputs from these new phrasings were examined before registration. No model, threshold or later rule will be fitted to these 12.
